headline: Ford swings to a loss as EBIT margin compresses
summary_short: Ford's Q2 FY2026 revenue was $48,296M, up 11.7% q/q but down 3.8% y/y, while the company swung to a net loss of $1,327M and diluted EPS of -$0.33 as EBIT fell to -$1,668M.
summary_long: Revenue was $48,296M (+11.7% q/q, -3.8% y/y). Gross profit fell to $3,322M (-35.3% q/q). Operating income dropped to $638M (-72.6% q/q) and EBIT swung to -$1,668M from +$3,266M q/q. EBITDA was -$236M, down from +$4,691M q/q. Net income was -$1,327M, versus -$36M a year ago and +$2,548M last quarter. Diluted EPS was -$0.33 versus $0.63 q/q and -$0.01 y/y.
